The SRFs SVO cites are on SSEC's anonymous FTP (ftp://ftp.ssec.wisc.edu/paulv/SRF_Data/netCDF/vas_g07.srf.nc), which has no statement; the netCDF attributes carry no notice ('Interpolated SRFs for transmittance production; Data obtained from HMW'). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
